reader.requirement: With more than one report in the program, an unqualified PAGE-COUNTER in the Procedure Division (declaratives included, sending or receiving) is refused; in the Report Section an unqualified PAGE-COUNTER means the enclosing RD's counter, and another report's counter is reached by explicit report-name qualification.

reader.notes: ReportOf answers a qualifier by report-name, an unqualified Report Section reference by the enclosing RD (set by BindReportClauses), and an unqualified Procedure Division reference only when one report is nearest in scope. Residual reading: a contained program with its own RD that also sees a container's GLOBAL RD resolves an unqualified PAGE-COUNTER to its own; I read 'more than one PAGE-COUNTER exists in a program' as the program's own reports, so this is taken as conforming.

refuter.evidence: IPC cases: X.4.4.4 GR1 makes a GLOBAL RD's PAGE-COUNTER a global name. n_two_global_unq (container with two GLOBAL RDs; a contained program with no RD writes an unqualified MOVE PAGE-COUNTER) is refused with COBOL2729 at the contained program's line 37: two PAGE-COUNTERs exist there. n_one_global_unq (container with one GLOBAL RD and one local RD; the contained program sees only the global one) accepts it, and it resolves to the global counter: INNER-UNQ=0040, and the contained program's ADD 1 makes OUTER-A=0041. n_pc_container_unq (container and contained program each with one RD of the same name, unqualified in both) accepts both: OUTER-UNQ=5, INNER-UNQ=3. The reader's residual reading (a contained program's own RD hides a container's GLOBAL one) agrees with §1985:X.1.3.8.2 GR3a: 'If the name is declared in program B, the object in program B is the referenced object' ('OK  §1985:X.1.3.8.2 GR3a ... the text is in GR3a'). cite.py: 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.5.5 SR3 ...'; 'OK  §1985:X.4.4.4 GR1 ...'.
